description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink project and checks for duplicate test case names. It processes input parameters, checks user rights, and interacts with a tree structure to verify if a test case name already exists, then outputs a JSON response.
published: since it's a typical script that outputs JSON and does not declare symbols to be used elsewhere

classes.name: tlInputParameter
classes.description: Handles input parameter validation for the 'name' and 'testcase_id' parameters.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: Represents a tree structure used to manage test case nodes, including checking for existing node names.

methods.name: nodeNameExists
methods.description: Checks if a node with the given name exists within the tree of test cases.
